candidates.title: South Korea tests hypersonic missile: A new threat to North Korea's underground bunkers?
candidates.excerpt: South Korea has successfully conducted a test of its domestically developed hypersonic boost-glide vehicle. This new missile system aims to enhance Seoul's ability to target North Korean sites as tensions rise. The hypersonic weapon can also potentially penetrate deeply buried targets, showcasing its destructive power. Similar developments are being pursued by other countries, including the United States and India.
